question: What were total sales by territory last year?
answer:
Total sales in 2024 were led by Southwest, with Southwest, Canada, and Northwest taking the top three spots.

- Southwest: $9,121,931.65
- Canada: $6,231,209.96
- Northwest: $6,018,432.58
- Lowest territory was Southeast at $2,399,947.38

Chart: chart_1  
Checked with: q1

periods.note: 'Last year' means 2024. 'Last quarter' means 2025-Q2 (data stops on 2025-06-29, so it is missing its last 1 day(s); say so).

dictionary.dialect: SQLite. Use strftime() for dates, LIMIT (not TOP), || to join text. Read-only.

main_view.name: sales_lines
main_view.grain: one row per order line (one product on one sales order)

columns.week_start: Monday of the order's week, YYYY-MM-DD
columns.territory: sales territory: Northwest, Northeast, Central, Southwest, Southeast, Canada, France, Germany, Australia, United Kingdom
columns.country: country code (US, CA, FR, DE, AU, GB)
columns.revenue: LineTotal: money for the line after discount

dictionary.raw_tables: SalesOrderHeader, SalesOrderDetail, Product, ProductSubcategory, ProductCategory, SalesTerritory, Customer (Microsoft's original column names). Prefer sales_lines.
caveats: standard_cost is today's cost for each product, not the cost at the time of the order.
The first month (2022-05) only has a few days of data.

tables_and_columns.SalesOrderDetail: SalesOrderID, SalesOrderDetailID, CarrierTrackingNumber, OrderQty, ProductID, SpecialOfferID, UnitPrice, UnitPriceDiscount, LineTotal
tables_and_columns.SalesOrderHeader: SalesOrderID, RevisionNumber, OrderDate, DueDate, ShipDate, Status, OnlineOrderFlag, SalesOrderNumber, PurchaseOrderNumber, AccountNumber, CustomerID, SalesPersonID, TerritoryID, BillToAddressID, ShipToAddressID, ShipMethodID, CreditCardID, CreditCardApprovalCode, CurrencyRateID, SubTotal, TaxAmt, Freight, TotalDue, Comment

args.query:
SELECT territory, SUM(revenue) AS total_sales
FROM sales_lines
WHERE year = 2024
GROUP BY territory
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;
